newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto-Dominion files for C$400 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Toronto-Dominion files for C$400 mln debt.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Wednesday that it is filing a preliminary prospectus with Canadian securities administrators for an offering of C$400 million worth of debentures due 2006.
The bank said interest on the debentures will be paid at the rate of 5.60 percent a year on March 5 and September 5 in each year until September 5, 2001.
After that date interest on the debentures will be payable at the Bankers' Acceptance Rate plus one percent payable quarterly on the 5th day of March, June, September and December.
The issue will be redeemable at par with the prior approval of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI) at the option of the bank on or after September 5, 2001.
As subordinated indebtedness the Debentures will qualify as capital under the rules established by OSFI.

The issue has been purchased from the Bank by an underwriting group consisting of TD Securities Inc., ScotiaMcLeod Inc, RBC Dominion Securities Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, Nesbitt Burns Inc, Midland Walwyn Capital Inc, Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion Inc, Goldman Sachs Canada Inc, Merrill Lynch Canada Inc and Trilon Securities Corporation.
The issue will close on February 27, 1997, subject to regulatory approvals.
